In the second video of our AIO (all-in-one) concept for Bass OS Android 14. we are rebooting from Tablet UI into desktop mode for the first time.

link_preview.title: POC: Bass OS - AIO - Android 14: Desktop mode
link_preview.description_html: This is another proof of concept demo of our all-in-one version of Bass OS. In this demo we are rebooting from tablet mode and into desktop mode
